facts.text: Off-road stopping performance is specified kinematically from brake-control actuation to standstill, including system response but excluding operator reaction, with payload and adverse configuration prescribed in testing under ISO 3450, ISO 10265, MSHA Table M-1 and New South Wales guidance.

facts.text: Grade and mass corrections are essential for off-road stopping calculations.

facts.text: NIOSH's stopping model demonstrates that grade, initial speed, brake force, brake lag and rolling or terrain resistance all materially affect off-road stopping.

facts.text: Service, secondary and parking braking functions on off-road machines need distinct treatment.

facts.text: A hydrostatic drive may slow an off-road machine but cannot replace a parking brake.

facts.text: An off-road intervention system should reason in terms of detection, determination, action, stopping and safe clearance.
